score_reasons.quality: Watercolor-plus-colored-pencil texture is consistent and controlled across the whole sheet: bark-like landmasses, layered blue sea wash, clean object edges and no structural breakage; all twelve food illustrations are structurally coherent (steamers, bowls, crabs, rolls). Tiny recommendation lines soften into semi-legible strokes at viewing resolution, which is the only quality caveat.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Outstanding picture-book charm: warm bayberry-red accents against sea-blue and turmeric-yellow fields, a vine-and-seafood border that frames without crowding, clear visual hierarchy from title to numbered spots to legend, and a cohesive cute hand-drawn style that stays uniform across dozens of elements.
score_reasons.alignment: Nearly everything requested is present: bird's-eye simplified map base; region labels 椒江/路桥/黄岩/临海/温岭/玉环/仙居/三门/天台; water names 灵江 and 台州湾; twelve numbered food spots matching the list (蛋清羊尾, 食饼筒, 青蟹, 海鲜面, 糟羹, 炊圆, 麦虾, 八大碗, 饺饼筒, 麦油脂, 嵌糕, 姜汁调蛋) with handwritten names and recommendation lines; vine/bayberry/shellfish border; compass with 东海 direction; legend box; fat rounded title 台州·山海食光地图 decorated with berries and a fish; square 1:1 ratio. Minor gaps: spot ③'s label appears to possibly read 香蟹 rather than the required 青蟹 (cannot fully resolve at this resolution), and several recommendation lines are too small to verify verbatim.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: The depicted foods are genuine Taizhou specialties with plausible appearances (green mud crab with ginger-vinegar dish, eight-bowl feast, glutinous cuan yuan in steamer, blue-white porcelain for ginger-egg custard); geography is directionally sensible (灵江 flowing to 台州湾, 东海 to the east, coastal islands); no cultural missteps found.
score_reasons.creative_generation: A richly imagined fusion of cartography, gastronomy and illustration: numbered culinary tour logic, per-spot taglines, decorative border narrative, compass and legend world-building; information density is high yet organized with excellent hierarchy and seamless multi-element integration.
